verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כִשְׁמֹ֣עַ כָּֽל־ הַמְּלָכִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן בָּהָ֣ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֗ה וּבְכֹל֙ ח֚וֹף הַיָּ֣ם הַגָּד֔וֹל אֶל־ מ֖וּל הַלְּבָנ֑וֹן הַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên bā·hār ū·ḇaš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇə·ḵōl ḥō·wp̄ hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’el- mūl hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Now when news of this reached all the kings west of the Jordan those in the hill country the foothills and all along the coast of the Great Sea toward . . . Lebanon the Hittites Amorites Canaanites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: Tendo ouvido isso todos os reis que estavam além do Jordão, na região montanhosa, na Sefelá e em toda a costa do grande mar defronte do Líbano (os heteus, os amorreus, os cananeus, os ferezeus, os heveus e os jebuseus),

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם עִם־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְעִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל פֶּ֖ה אֶחָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū yaḥ·dāw lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·‘im- yiś·rā·’êl peh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: they came together . . . . . . to wage war against Joshua . . . and Israel
verses.literalPt: de comum acordo, reuniram-se para pelejar contra Josué e contra Israel.

verses.original: וְיֹשְׁבֵ֨י גִבְע֜וֹן שָׁמְע֗וּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ לִֽירִיח֖וֹ וְלָעָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn šā·mə·‘ū ’êṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lî·rî·ḥōw wə·lā·‘āy
verses.literal: But the people of Gibeon having heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai
verses.literalPt: Porém os habitantes de Gibeão, tendo ouvido o que fizera Josué a Jericó e a Ai,

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ גַם־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ בְּעָרְמָ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ וַיִּצְטַיָּ֑רוּ וַיִּקְח֞וּ שַׂקִּ֤ים בָּלִים֙ לַחֲמ֣וֹרֵיהֶ֔ם וְנֹאד֥וֹת יַ֙יִן֙ בָּלִ֔ים וּמְבֻקָּעִ֖ים וּמְצֹרָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḡam- hêm·māh bə·‘ā·rə·māh way·yê·lə·ḵū way·yiṣ·ṭay·yā·rū way·yiq·ḥū śaq·qîm bā·lîm la·ḥă·mō·w·rê·hem wə·nō·ḏō·wṯ ya·yin bā·lîm ū·mə·ḇuq·qā·‘îm ū·mə·ṣō·rā·rîm
verses.literal: acted deceptively . . . . . . . . . and set out as envoys carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins . . . cracked and mended
verses.literalPt: usaram de astúcia: foram e se fingiram embaixadores, carregando sobre os seus jumentos sacos velhos e odres velhos, rotos e consertados,

verses.original: וּנְעָל֨וֹת בָּל֤וֹת וּמְטֻלָּאוֹת֙ בְּרַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וּשְׂלָמ֥וֹת בָּל֖וֹת עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְכֹל֙ לֶ֣חֶם צֵידָ֔ם יָבֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֥ה נִקֻּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·‘ā·lō·wṯ bā·lō·wṯ ū·mə·ṭul·lā·’ō·wṯ bə·raḡ·lê·hem ū·śə·lā·mō·wṯ bā·lō·wṯ ‘ă·lê·hem wə·ḵōl le·ḥem ṣê·ḏām yā·ḇêš hā·yāh niq·qu·ḏîm
verses.literal: They put worn patched sandals on their feet and threadbare clothing on their bodies and their whole supply of bread was dry . . . and moldy
verses.literalPt: tendo nos pés sapatos velhos e remendados e trajando roupas velhas. Todo o pão de que se proveram era seco e havia-se tornado bolorento.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַגִּלְגָּ֑ל וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו וְאֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵאֶ֤רֶץ רְחוֹקָה֙ בָּ֔אנוּ וְעַתָּ֖ה כִּרְתוּ־ לָ֥נוּ בְרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh hag·gil·gāl way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw wə·’el- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·w·qāh bā·nū wə·‘at·tāh kir·ṯū- lā·nū ḇə·rîṯ
verses.literal: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel We have come . . . from a distant land please make a treaty with us
verses.literalPt: Foram ter com Josué ao acampamento em Gilgal e disseram-lhe a ele e a todos os homens de Israel: Somos vindos de uma terra longínqua; fazei, agora, aliança conosco.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ הַחִוִּ֑י אוּלַ֗י בְּקִרְבִּי֙ אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְאֵ֖יךְ אֶכְרוֹת לְךָ֥ בְרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ha·ḥiw·wî ’ū·lay bə·qir·bî ’at·tāh yō·wō·šêḇ wə·’êḵ ʾɛḵ·rōṯ lə·ḵā ḇə·rîṯ
verses.literal: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites Perhaps you dwell near us How can we make . . . a treaty with you
verses.literalPt: Responderam os homens de Israel aos heveus: Talvez habiteis entre nós; como, pois, faremos aliança convosco?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֧ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מִ֥י אַתֶּ֖ם וּמֵאַ֥יִן תָּבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ mî ’at·tem ū·mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·’ū
verses.literal: We are your servants they said to Joshua Then Joshua asked them . . . Who are you and where have you come from
verses.literalPt: Tornaram a Josué: Nós somos teus servos. Então, lhes perguntou Josué: Quem sois vós? donde vindes?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו מֵאֶ֨רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֤ה מְאֹד֙ בָּ֣אוּ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ שָׁמְע֔וֹ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw mê·’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·w·qāh mə·’ōḏ bā·’ū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî- šā·ma‘·nū šā·mə·‘ōw wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Your servants have come from a very distant land they replied . . . because of the fame of the LORD your God For we have heard the reports about Him all that He did in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhe: Duma terra mui longínqua são vindos teus servos, por causa do nome de Jeová, teu Deus, porque temos ouvido a sua fama, e tudo o que fez no Egito,

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לִשְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן לְסִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וּלְע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּעַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh liš·nê mal·ḵê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên lə·sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn ū·lə·‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ- hab·bā·šān ’ă·šer bə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan who reigned in Ashtaroth
verses.literalPt: e tudo quanto fez aos dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão, a Seom, rei de Hesbom, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, que estava em Astarote.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֵ֡ינוּ זְֽקֵינֵינוּ֩ וְכָל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י אַרְצֵ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר קְח֨וּ בְיֶדְכֶ֤ם צֵידָה֙ לַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּלְכ֖וּ לִקְרָאתָ֑ם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֲלֵיהֶם֙ עַבְדֵיכֶ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְעַתָּ֖ה כִּרְתוּ־ לָ֥נוּ בְרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lê·nū zə·qê·nê·nū wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ’ar·ṣê·nū lê·mōr qə·ḥū ḇə·yeḏ·ḵem ṣê·ḏāh lad·de·reḵ ū·lə·ḵū liq·rā·ṯām wa·’ă·mar·tem ’ă·lê·hem ‘aḇ·ḏê·ḵem ’ă·naḥ·nū wə·‘at·tāh kir·ṯū- lā·nū ḇə·rîṯ
verses.literal: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us Take provisions for your journey go to meet them and say to them We . . . are your servants Please make a treaty with us
verses.literalPt: Os nossos anciãos e todos os habitantes da nossa terra nos disseram: Tomai nas mãos provisão para o caminho, e ide-lhes ao encontro, e dizei-lhes: Nós somos vossos servos; fazei, agora, aliança conosco.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה׀ לַחְמֵ֗נוּ חָ֞ם הִצְטַיַּ֤דְנוּ אֹתוֹ֙ מִבָּ֣תֵּ֔ינוּ בְּי֥וֹם צֵאתֵ֖נוּ לָלֶ֣כֶת אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָבֵ֔שׁ וְהָיָ֖ה נִקֻּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zeh laḥ·mê·nū ḥām hiṣ·ṭay·yaḏ·nū ’ō·ṯōw mib·bāt·tê·nū bə·yō·wm ṣê·ṯê·nū lā·le·ḵeṯ ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh yā·ḇêš wə·hā·yāh niq·qu·ḏîm
verses.literal: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you But look it is now dry and moldy
verses.literalPt: Este nosso pão, tomamo-lo quente das nossas casas para a nossa provisão no dia em que saímos para ir ter convosco; mas eis que, agora, está seco e já se tornou bolorento;

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה נֹאד֤וֹת הַיַּ֙יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֣אנוּ חֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְהִנֵּ֖ה הִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ וְאֵ֤לֶּה שַׂלְמוֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּנְעָלֵ֔ינוּ בָּל֕וּ מֵרֹ֥ב הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh nō·ḏō·wṯ hay·ya·yin ’ă·šer mil·lê·nū ḥă·ḏā·šîm wə·hin·nêh hiṯ·baq·qā·‘ū wə·’êl·leh śal·mō·w·ṯê·nū ū·nə·‘ā·lê·nū bā·lū mê·rōḇ had·de·reḵ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: These wineskins . . . were new when we filled them but look they are cracked And these clothes and sandals are worn out from our very long journey
verses.literalPt: estes odres que enchemos de vinho eram novos e eis que, agora, são rotos; estes nossos vestidos e os nossos sapatos já se envelheceram em razão do mui longo caminho.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֥וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצֵּידָ֑ם וְאֶת־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א שָׁאָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū hā·’ă·nā·šîm miṣ·ṣê·ḏām wə·’eṯ- pî Yah·weh lō šā·’ā·lū
verses.literal: Then the men of Israel sampled their provisions but did not seek the counsel of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os homens tomaram da provisão deles e não pediram conselhos à boca de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ לָהֶ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וַיִּכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית לְחַיּוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבְע֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם נְשִׂיאֵ֖י הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lā·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ šā·lō·wm way·yiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem bə·rîṯ lə·ḥay·yō·w·ṯām way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū lā·hem nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them
verses.literalPt: Josué também fez paz com eles e estabeleceu uma aliança para lhes poupar a vida; e os príncipes da congregação lhes juraram.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקְצֵה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֕י אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרְת֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֑ית וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֗וּ כִּי־ קְרֹבִ֥ים הֵם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וּבְקִרְבּ֖וֹ הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·ṣêh šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer- kā·rə·ṯū lā·hem bə·rîṯ way·yiš·mə·‘ū kî- qə·rō·ḇîm hêm ’ê·lāw ū·ḇə·qir·bōw hêm yō·šə·ḇîm
verses.literal: Three days after they had made the treaty with the Gibeonites the Israelites learned that they were neighbors living among them . . .
verses.literalPt: Ao fim de três dias depois de terem feito aliança com eles, ouviram que eram os seus vizinhos e que moravam no meio deles.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל־ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וְעָרֵיהֶם֙ גִּבְע֣וֹן וְהַכְּפִירָ֔ה וּבְאֵר֖וֹת וְקִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ‘ā·rê·hem bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî wə·‘ā·rê·hem giḇ·‘ō·wn wə·hak·kə·p̄î·rāh ū·ḇə·’ê·rō·wṯ wə·qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . set out and on the third day arrived . . . at their cities Gibeon Chephirah Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido os filhos de Israel, chegaram, no terceiro dia, às cidades deles. Ora, as suas cidades eram Gibeão, Quefira, Beerote e Quiriate-Jearim.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א הִכּוּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ נִשְׁבְּע֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בַּֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּלֹּ֥נוּ כָל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה עַל־ הַנְּשִׂיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hik·kūm bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî- niš·bə·‘ū lā·hem nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl way·yil·lō·nū ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh ‘al- han·nə·śî·’îm
verses.literal: But the Israelites . . . did not attack them because the leaders of the congregation had sworn an oath to them by the LORD the God of Israel And the whole congregation grumbled against the leaders
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel não os feriram, porque os príncipes da congregação lhes haviam jurado por Jeová, Deus de Israel. Então, toda a congregação murmurou contra os príncipes.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל־ הַנְּשִׂיאִים֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְנוּ לָהֶ֔ם בַּֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֕ה לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לִנְגֹּ֥עַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ḵāl han·nə·śî·’îm ’el- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’ă·naḥ·nū niš·ba‘·nū lā·hem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘at·tāh lō nū·ḵal lin·gō·a‘ bā·hem
verses.literal: All the leaders . . . answered - We have sworn an oath to them by the LORD the God of Israel and now we cannot . . . touch them
verses.literalPt: Mas todos os príncipes disseram a toda a congregação: Nós lhes juramos por Jeová, Deus de Israel; agora, não os podemos tocar.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם וְהַחֲיֵ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ יִֽהְיֶ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ קֶ֔צֶף עַל־ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְנוּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·‘ă·śeh lā·hem wə·ha·ḥă·yêh ’ō·w·ṯām wə·lō- yih·yeh ‘ā·lê·nū qe·ṣep̄ ‘al- haš·šə·ḇū·‘āh ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·nū lā·hem
verses.literal: This is how we will treat them We will let them live so that no wrath will fall on us because of the oath we swore to them
verses.literalPt: Isso lhes faremos e os deixaremos viver, para que não venha grande ira sobre nós, por faltarmos ao juramento que lhes fizemos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֧וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֛ם הַנְּשִׂיאִ֖ים יִֽחְי֑וּ וַ֠יִּֽהְיוּ חֹטְבֵ֨י עֵצִ֤ים וְשֹֽׁאֲבֵי־ מַ֙יִם֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבְּר֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם הַנְּשִׂיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem han·nə·śî·’îm yiḥ·yū way·yih·yū ḥō·ṭə·ḇê ‘ê·ṣîm wə·šō·’ă·ḇê- ma·yim lə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh ka·’ă·šer dib·bə·rū lā·hem han·nə·śî·’îm
verses.literal: They continued . . . Let them live but let them be woodcutters . . . and water carriers for the whole congregation So the leaders kept their promise
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhes os príncipes: Vivam. Assim, se tornaram rachadores de lenha e tiradores de água para toda a congregação, como os príncipes lhes haviam dito.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לָמָּה֩ רִמִּיתֶ֨ם אֹתָ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר רְחוֹקִ֨ים אֲנַ֤חְנוּ מִכֶּם֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּקִרְבֵּ֥נוּ יֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā lā·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem lê·mōr lām·māh rim·mî·ṯem ’ō·ṯā·nū lê·mōr rə·ḥō·w·qîm ’ă·naḥ·nū mik·kem mə·’ōḏ wə·’at·tem bə·qir·bê·nū yō·šə·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said Why did you deceive us . . . by telling us you live far away . . . from us when in fact you live among us
verses.literalPt: Chamou-os Josué e disse-lhes: Por que nos enganastes, dizendo: Nós habitamos mui longe de vós; quando habitais entre nós?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אֲרוּרִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֨ת מִכֶּ֜ם עֶ֗בֶד וְחֹטְבֵ֥י עֵצִ֛ים וְשֹֽׁאֲבֵי־ מַ֖יִם לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·rū·rîm ’at·tem wə·lō- yik·kā·rêṯ mik·kem ‘e·ḇeḏ wə·ḥō·ṭə·ḇê ‘ê·ṣîm wə·šō·’ă·ḇê- ma·yim lə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Now therefore you are under a curse and will perpetually . . . . . . serve as woodcutters . . . and water carriers for the house of my God
verses.literalPt: Agora, sois malditos, e dentre vós nunca deixará de haver escravos, rachadores de lenha e tiradores de água, para a Casa do meu Deus.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ כִּי֩ הֻגֵּ֨ד הֻגַּ֤ד לַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔וֹ לָתֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְהַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת־ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וַנִּירָ֨א מְאֹ֤ד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וַֽנַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yō·mə·rū kî hug·gêḏ hug·gaḏ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dōw lā·ṯêṯ lā·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·nê·ḵem wan·nî·rā mə·’ōḏ lə·nap̄·šō·ṯê·nū mip·pə·nê·ḵem wan·na·‘ă·śêh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: The Gibeonites answered - . . . Your servants . . . were told clearly that the LORD your God had commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land and wipe out all its inhabitants . . . before you So we greatly feared for our lives because of you and that is why we have done - this
verses.literalPt: Então, responderam a Josué: Foi anunciado aos teus servos, como Jeová, teu Deus, ordenou aos seu servo Moisés que vos desse toda a terra e que destruísse diante de vós todos os habitantes da mesma; por isso, temíamos de vós pelas nossas vidas, e fizemos isso.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה הִנְנ֣וּ בְיָדֶ֑ךָ כַּטּ֨וֹב וְכַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֖נוּ עֲשֵֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nū ḇə·yā·ḏe·ḵā kaṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·ḵay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·nū ‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: Now . . . we are in your hands Do to us whatever seems good and right to you
verses.literalPt: Eis que, agora, estamos nas tuas mãos; faze-nos o que te parecer bom e justo que se nos faça.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ לָהֶ֖ם כֵּ֑ן וַיַּצֵּ֥ל אוֹתָ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְלֹ֥א הֲרָגֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lā·hem kên way·yaṣ·ṣêl ’ō·w·ṯām mî·yaḏ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō hă·rā·ḡūm
verses.literal: So Joshua did this and delivered them from the hands of the Israelites and they did not kill the Gibeonites
verses.literalPt: Assim lhes fez e livrou-os das mãos dos filhos de Israel, de sorte que os não mataram.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנֵ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא חֹטְבֵ֥י עֵצִ֛ים וְשֹׁ֥אֲבֵי מַ֖יִם לָֽעֵדָ֑ה וּלְמִזְבַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nêm yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bay·yō·wm ha·hū ḥō·ṭə·ḇê ‘ê·ṣîm wə·šō·’ă·ḇê ma·yim lā·‘ê·ḏāh ū·lə·miz·baḥ Yah·weh ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥār
verses.literal: On that day he made them woodcutters . . . and water carriers as they are to this day . . . . . . for the congregation of the LORD and for the altar at the place He would choose
verses.literalPt: Nesse dia, Josué fê-los rachadores de lenha e tiradores de água para a congregação e para o altar de Jeová, no lugar que escolhesse, como se vê até o dia de hoje.
